NinjaTrader Guide, Cash Accounts

Assigning Algos and Strategies to Your Cash Account

This walks you through reconnecting your algos in NinjaTrader after the 9.0 updater, loading each one with the exact set file the Cash Allocation Tool gave you, assigning it to the right cash account, then clearing out the old strategies once the new ones are running.

Every screenshot below has the item to click boxed in orange. Your progress is saved on this device.

Cash setup at a glance

Three pages, done in order. Complete all of it inside your VPS.

  1. 1Install the updaterDownload, extract, and run the five numbered tools on your VPS.
  2. 2Cash Allocation ToolEnter your account balances and get the exact set file for each algo.
  3. 3Assign algosLoad each set file into its strategy on the right account.You are here
0 of 6 steps complete

Tick each step as you go.

  1. 1

    Log into NinjaTrader

    A minute or two

    Your strategies connect to your cash account through NinjaTrader, so it needs to be fully loaded before you start assigning anything.

    1. Double click the red NinjaTrader icon on your desktop.
    2. Log into your NinjaTrader.
    3. Wait until NinjaTrader is fully loaded before moving to the next step.
    4. Keep the Cash Allocation Tool page open with your Account Recommendations. It lists the exact set file for each algo on each account.
  2. 2

    Open the strategies list on the chart

    A minute

    This opens the list of strategies you can load onto that chart. This walkthrough uses MST as the example; the same steps apply to every algo.

    1. Along the bottom of the chart window, click the algo's own chart tab (MST2-10M-YM here).
    2. Click in the blank area next to the red and green candles, not on a candle (clicking a candle drops a marker dot).
    3. Right click there and choose Strategies...
    4. The Strategies box opens. Your algos are listed on the left under Available: B2X, G4M, MST, OGX, RBO and URGO. Find yours, the version without PF in the name (MST-3.3 here).
  3. 3

    Load the algo and its 9.0 set file

    About 2 minutes per algo

    Double clicking moves the strategy into Configured. Loading the exact set file the allocator named sets the size to match your plan.

    1. Double click your algo in the Available list. It drops down into Configured.
    2. At the bottom right of the Properties panel, click template, then load.
    3. In the Load Strategy Template box, click the exact file name from the allocator (Account 1 in the allocator example: 0 - Default - MST - YM - 10 Minute - $20,000 Allocation Set File), then click Load.
    4. Check that Fixed account size ($) now reads 20000, matching that set file.
    9.0 set file names. Each algo has numbered files: 0 - Default; 01 to 09 ($10,000 to $90,000 Allocation Set File); 10 to 13 (larger Allocation Set Files); 14 to 17 (100%, 50%, 33%, 25% Split Account Balance - Compounding Model); 18 (High Risk - FULL ACCOUNT BALANCE - Compounding Model). Always use the exact name the allocator shows.
  4. 4

    Select your cash account and apply

    A minute

    This is what turns the algo on for your cash account.

    1. In Properties under Setup, click the Account drop-down (in some strategies it is further down the panel).
    2. Choose the cash account the allocator assigned this algo to.
    3. Click Apply, then OK.
    4. Confirm the strategy shows up in your Strategies tab.
    You will repeat this assigning process each time there is an updater. Balances below the listed floors may still trade but carry greater drawdown risk.
  5. 5

    Repeat for the next algo

    A few minutes

    Each algo is assigned on its own chart, so you are not finished after the first one.

    1. Go to the next algo card in the allocator and find that algo's chart tab (for example RBO).
    2. Run steps 2 through 4 again for that algo, loading the set file the allocator shows for it.
    3. Keep going until every algo card on every account in the allocator is loaded.
  6. 6

    Remove the old strategies

    A minute

    Once the new strategies are assigned and confirmed, the old ones from before the updater should come out so your Strategies tab only shows what is running.

    1. In the Control Center, open the Strategies tab.
    2. Select the old strategy or strategies from before the updater.
    3. Right click and choose Remove.

  7. Strategies reassigned

    Your algos are reconnected and assigned to your cash accounts with the 9.0 set files from the allocator, with the old pre-updater strategies removed. If anything looks off, open a support ticket in the Vincere Discord: support, submit-ticket.
